_comment: Pre-registered pilot acceptance criteria (docs/PILOT_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA.md). Every value is null ON PURPOSE: the project team / faculty must choose and approve each one BEFORE `freeze`. The tool refuses to freeze while any value is null or the approval is not documented (approved_by, approved_on, approval_evidence), and refuses to score if this file changes after freezing. Rules: ci_upper_below_zero = the engine's paired MAE difference must have a 95% CI entirely below 0 (clearly better); point_estimate_not_worse = the engine's MAE must not exceed the other system's; report_only = reported without pass/fail.
approved_by: <roles/names of the approving project team members or faculty>
approval_evidence: <reference to the approval record: signed minutes, e-mail id or document number - kept by the supervisor>
